svg.title: Patro for Android and iPhone
svg.desc: Android in closed beta, iPhone in progress. A calendar app with home and lock screen widgets, a festival list and a date converter. No ads, no account, no network permission. Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · Swift · SwiftUI
